text:
andre: Heads-up — nightly eval spike on `dialogue-coherence` after merge of layout-rewrite v2 (PR #4821). We're seeing entropy oscillation during sampling and lots of short repeats.

tara: same here, grep'd the failing runs. Example from run 2026-03-19T02:45Z: "I want to I want to I want to..." — repeated token bursts around token 12-18.

samir: my suspicion is RNG state reuse across microbatches. The layout rewrite changed how we thread RNG through the fused kernels; might be accidentally sharing state between requests.

liam: flagged the PR change that touched `rng_linker` + `microbatch.cu`. Diff snippet from the merge:```diff
- rng_state = init_rng(request_id);
+ rng_state = global_rng_linker->acquire_state(); // reuse across microbatches
```

ci-bot: nightly-eval/job-2026-03-19 #4821 failed 5 tests in `dialogue-coherence`.

eve: repro steps that worked for me locally: `python -m eval_runner --model grove-7b --prompt sets/dialogue-coherence.txt --seed 42 --quant q4f --runs 10`. Alternating entropy traces per token: high, low, high, low -> causes partial repeats.

andre: Can anyone confirm whether hosted/dedicated production traffic saw similar regression? Telemetry shows a tiny tail (~2% of requests) with long repeated fragments starting ~02:30 UTC, likely from canaries.

tara: starting a git-bisect now to confirm commit. If it's indeed RNG reuse, a quick revert of the `rng_linker` change should drop the failure rate.

samir: pushed a minimal patch to isolate RNG per request: branch `fix/rng-isolate-4821`. It forces per-request RNG seeds before microbatching. Running quick evals now.

liam: we should also add a sampling unit test that runs short stochastic traces with microbatch size >1 and asserts no across-request correlation in token distributions.

andre: Plan proposal: 1) deploy `fix/rng-isolate-4821` to nightly-canary at 10% 2) run full `dialogue-coherence` eval and quick regression suite 3) if pass -> promote fix to canary 100% and schedule revert/patch merge for main. Tagging @oncall.

eve: attaching short log excerpt (entropy + kv rotate timestamps):```
[02:44:12.123] request=abcd entropy=4.21 kv_rotate=1001
[02:44:12.124] request=abcd entropy=0.87 kv_rotate=1001
[02:44:12.125] request=efgh entropy=4.19 kv_rotate=1002
[02:44:12.126] request=efgh entropy=0.90 kv_rotate=1002
```

samir: quick numbers from the `fix` canary: pass rate on `dialogue-coherence` went from 62% -> 95% on 200-run sample. Initial signs look good. Opening PR to cherry-pick the fix into main and add the unit test.

liam: good. If the cherry-pick is clean, prefer that over full revert of layout rewrite. Also add a short post-merge eval gating job for sampling entropy stability.

andre: agreed. I'll shepherd the cherry-pick PR and follow up with a short postmortem once we decide whether to revert any parts of the layout rewrite. Thanks all.

ci-bot: deployed `fix/rng-isolate-4821` to nightly-canary (10%) at 03:12 UTC and queued evals.
